interface.longDescription:
QuickInvoice is a finance tool for freelancers and small businesses: it creates professional PDF invoices and tracks which ones have been paid. Say "invoice Acme $1,200 for the logo design, due in 14 days" and get a clean, professional PDF invoice with line items, tax/VAT, discounts, due date, payment details and an online payment link.

It handles any currency and prints on A4 or US Letter automatically. Names and addresses in Latin, Greek and Cyrillic scripts are supported.

When you sign in, QuickInvoice remembers your business details and logo, numbers your invoices automatically (INV-0001, INV-0002…), keeps your invoices, and tracks who has paid. Ask "which invoices are overdue?" or "Acme paid INV-0042" anytime.
defaultPrompt: Invoice Acme GmbH €1,200 for logo design, due in 14 days
Create an invoice for 10 hours of consulting at $95/hour with 8% sales tax
